messages:
Marisa: Quick check — we need final audience segmentation for the launch newsletter. Goal: 3 cohorts (power users, trialers <7d, new signups). Thoughts?
Sam (Growth): +1. I'd merge trialers <7d with new signups for the first email, separate for follow-ups.
Asha: For the benchmark narrative, let's include the latency/cost chart and the short case study blurb. Draft in doc: https://docs.redwood.com/launch-email-draft — please add comments.
Evan: Timing? I suggest Wed 10am PT. Also run a subject multivariate test: 3 variants, opens -> clicks -> webinar RSVP as the funnel.
Marisa: Agree Wed 10am PT. Sam can you set up the A/B in SendGrid? Example snippet to reference: `sendgrid.create_campaign({name: 'launch-01', segments: []})`
Sam (Growth): On it. I'll create two dynamic segments: `cohort_power` and `cohort_new_trial`. Also will apply suppression for users with `do-not-email`.
Asha: Content order: primary CTA = webinar signup, secondary CTA = benchmarks doc/short TL;DR. Keep hero copy punchy, one metric up front.
Evan: Webinar invite — propose Thurs (4 days post-send) at 11am PT so we have one nurture + reminder.
Marisa: Can we add in-email RSVP buttons that ping the registration endpoint and include `utm_campaign=launch_webinar`? Need analytics to stitch back to email_id.
Sam (Growth): Yep. I'll add utm params and an `email_id` macro. Also will add a hidden input on the RSVP to capture segment.
launchbot: Reminder set: Send sequence 1 scheduled for 2301234600. :bell: Automated follow-ups will run for 72h after send.
Marisa: Final ask — paste final subject lines and preheaders here by EOD so I can approve.
Asha: Draft subjects: [1] "See what's changed in inference — join the live demo" [2] "New: predictable latency for LLMs (benchmarks inside)" [3] "Redwood launch: benchmarks + live walkthrough"
Evan: Preheaders: "Benchmarks & best practices inside" / "Live demo seats limited" / "Read the quick benchmark summary"
Sam (Growth): I'll spin up the multivariate test, set winner criteria to CTR->RSVP conversion, and share campaign IDs in this thread when ready.
Marisa: Thanks team — please flag any blocking deliverables. If landing page copy is missing by 3pm PT I will push the send back. :raised_hands:
